title: Delete Old Temporary Files
description: Remove temporary files older than a configurable retention period.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

TEMP_DIR="${1:-/tmp}"
DAYS="${DAYS:-7}"

echo "Files in $TEMP_DIR older than $DAYS days:"

find "$TEMP_DIR" -type f -mtime "+$DAYS" -print

if [[ "${DRY_RUN:-true}" == "true" ]]; then
    echo "DRY_RUN=true: no files were deleted."
    exit 0
fi

find "$TEMP_DIR" -type f -mtime "+$DAYS" -delete

echo "Cleanup completed."
